messages.content: How would you respond to the following statement: My painful experiences and memories make it difficult for me to live a life that I would value.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I am not afraid of my feelings.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I worry about not being able to control my worries and feelings.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: My painful memories prevent me from having a fulfilling life.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Emotions do not cause problems in my life.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: It seems like most people are handling their lives better than I am.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Worries do not get in the way of my success.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: The key to a good life is never feeling pain.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I am not quick to leave situations that make me feel uneasy.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When unpleasant memories come to me, I do not try to push them out of my mind.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I feel disconnected from my emotions.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I won't do something until I absolutely have to.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Fear or anxiety won't stop me from doing something important.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I would not give up much just to avoid feeling bad.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I will still do something even if there is a chance that it will upset me.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: It's hard for me to know what I'm feeling.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I do not put off unpleasant tasks for as long as possible.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I do not go out of my way to avoid uncomfortable situations.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: One of my big goals is to be free from painful emotions.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I do not work hard to keep upsetting feelings away.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: If I have any doubts about doing something, I just won't do it.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Pain always leads to suffering.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
